title: Tai Tam Tuk Reservoir Dam

terrainReference.basis: Surveyed crest contact on the existing road, on the central curve.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap structure and road, with Antiquities and Monuments Office heritage boundary
mapIdentity.scope: The named OpenStreetMap dam shares ten positions with the native reservoir ring. The independent mapped crest road follows the curved crest across both major abutments. The official heritage boundary includes the downstream pool and adjacent bed.

note: Primary engineering sources document twelve arched openings under the road, two still in their granite form and ten with later concrete siphons. The exposed gravity wall follows the original terrain and meets the mapped downstream footbridge.
